note: Quantities the manuscript cites that are derived from the pipeline but appear inside no results/ file. Regenerate with `make facts`. atlas.check_manuscript_numbers compares the manuscript's stated guardrail count against guardrail_tests_collected rather than looking it up in the value pool: both 102 and 118 -- the counts this manuscript carried before -- match exactly one unrelated pipeline value each, so a stale count would be reported as verified. How many tests PASS depends on the checkout (a release archive ships data/ and results/, a git archive does not), so the passing count must be measured from the release at release time.
archive_measured_for_version: the v2.4.3 release archive (477 files), measured as a reader sees it: the submission-package checks need the author's own deliverables and skip without them, so the count does not depend on whose machine runs it. Measured on 2026-09-07 with HOME pointed at an empty directory: 178 passed, 24 skipped, 0 failed while Ensembl REST was intermittently returning 5xx; the single Ensembl-dependent live check (tests/test_mapping.py::test_ref_alleles_match_grch38_live) passes when the service answers (14/14 for tests/test_mapping.py in the same tree the same day), so with Ensembl REST reachable the pair is 179 passed, 23 skipped, which is the figure recorded, following the v2.4.2 convention
bare_clone_measured_for: a fresh clone of main at 7c4cea4, measured on 2026-09-07 with HOME pointed at an empty directory: 130 passed, 72 skipped; results/, data/ and the package absent. The v2.4.3 release commit changes version strings and this file only, so the pair is unchanged at the release commit. At the v2.4.2 signature commit the pair was 124 passed, 57 skipped, measured on 2026-09-05
